annotations.title: Disconnect a domain from a page

description: Stop a connected domain serving its page; the hermoso.page address keeps working. Without confirm:true nothing changes and you get what it would disconnect; call again with confirm:true once the user says yes. Free.

confirm.description: true only after the user approved it

hostname.description: the address to serve the page on: a subdomain such as go.brand.com or www.brand.com

name.description: the page name, which is its address: spring-sale is served at https://spring-sale.hermoso.page

name: disconnect_domain
